text_en: The words of Agur son of Jakeh. An oracle. Thus says the man: I am weary, O God, I am weary, O God. How can I prevail?
text_cn: 玛萨人雅刻之子阿古尔的格言，即他给依提耳、给依提耳和乌加耳的断语：

text_en: Surely I am too stupid to be human; I do not have human understanding.
text_cn: 我比谁都愚蠢，没有人的才智。

text_en: I have not learned wisdom, nor have I knowledge of the holy ones.
text_cn: 我从来没有学得智慧，致能通晓圣者的知识。

text_en: Who has ascended to heaven and come down? Who has gathered the wind in the hollow of the hand? Who has wrapped up the waters in a garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is the person’s name? And what is the name of the person’s child? Surely you know!
text_cn: 谁曾上升过天而又降下？谁能将风收集在手中？谁能将水聚集在大衣内？谁为这大地立定了边界？他叫什么名字？其子姓甚名谁？你知道吗？

text_en: Every word of God proves true; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
text_cn: 天主的每一句话，都是经火精炼的；凡托庇于他的人，他必要作其护盾。

text_en: Do not add to his words, or else he will rebuke you, and you will be found a liar.
text_cn: 对他所说的话，不可加添什么；免得他指责你，证明你在说谎。

text_en: Two things I ask of you; do not deny them to me before I die:
text_cn: 我求你两件事，在我未死以前，请不要拒绝我：

text_en: Remove far from me falsehood and lying; give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with the food that I need,
text_cn: 令虚伪和欺诈远离我，贫乏或富裕勿赐与我，只供予我必需的食粮，

text_en: or I shall be full, and deny you, and say, “Who is the Lord ? ” or I shall be poor, and steal, and profane the name of my God.
text_cn: 免得我吃饱了，背叛你说：“谁是上主？”或是过于贫乏，因而行窃，加辱我天主的名。

text_en: Do not slander a servant to a master, or the servant will curse you, and you will be held guilty.
text_cn: 别在主人前，诽谤他的奴仆，怕他咒骂你，你就不免受罚。

text_en: There are those who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers.
text_cn: 有一种人，咒骂父亲；自己母亲，也不祝福。

text_en: There are those who are pure in their own eyes yet are not cleansed of their filthiness.
text_cn: 有一种人，自视清高；自身污秽，却不洗涤。

text_en: There are those—how lofty are their eyes, how high their eyelids lift! —
text_cn: 有一种人，眼睛傲慢，目空一切。

text_en: there are those whose teeth are swords, whose teeth are knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, the needy from among mortals.
text_cn: 有一种人，牙如利剑，齿如快刀，地上弱小，人间贫民，吞食一空。

text_en: The leech has two daughters; “Give, give, ” they cry. Three things are never satisfied; four never say, “Enough”:
text_cn: 水蛭有两个女儿，常说“给我！给我！”不知足的东西，共有三样，总不说“够了”的，共有四样：

text_en: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth ever thirsty for water, and the fire that never says, “Enough. ”
text_cn: 即阴府、荒胎、总饮不足水的地，和总不说“够了”的火。

text_en: The eye that mocks a father and scorns to obey a mother will be pecked out by the ravens of the valley and eaten by the vultures.
text_cn: 谁嘲笑父亲，或轻视年老的母亲，愿他的眼睛，被谷中的乌鸦啄去，为小鹰所食。

text_en: Three things are too wonderful for me; four I do not understand:
text_cn: 令我称奇的事，共有三样，连我不明了的，共有四样：

text_en: the way of an eagle in the sky, the way of a snake on a rock, the way of a ship on the high seas, and the way of a man with a girl.
text_cn: 即鹰在天空飞翔的道，蛇在岩石爬行的道，船在海中航行的道，以及男女交合之道。

text_en: This is the way of an adulteress: she eats, and wipes her mouth, and says, “I have done no wrong. ”
text_cn: 淫妇的作风是这样：她吃了后，抹抹口说：“我并没有为非作歹。”

text_en: Under three things the earth trembles; under four it cannot bear up:
text_cn: 使地战栗的事，共有三样，连不可容忍的，共有四样：

text_en: a slave when he becomes king, and a fool when glutted with food;
text_cn: 即奴隶为王，愚人饱食，

text_en: an unloved woman when she gets a husband, and a maid when she succeeds her mistress.
text_cn: 丑女出嫁，婢女当家。

text_en: Four things on earth are small, yet they are exceedingly wise:
text_cn: 地上的小动物中，有四种极其聪明：

text_en: the ants are a people without strength, yet they provide their food in the summer;
text_cn: 蚂蚁是无力的一群，却在夏日储备食粮；

text_en: the badgers are a people without power, yet they make their homes in the rocks;
text_cn: 岩狸是无能的一群，却在岩石中筑巢穴；

text_en: the locusts have no king, yet all of them march in rank;
text_cn: 蝗虫虽然没有君王，却知一齐列队出发；

text_en: the lizard can be grasped in the hand, yet it is found in kings’ palaces.
text_cn: 壁虎能用手来捕捉，却经常出入于皇宫。

text_en: Three things are stately in their stride; four are stately in their gait:
text_cn: 举止昂然之物，共有三样，连威仪赫赫的，共有四样：

text_en: the lion, which is mightiest among wild animals and does not turn back before any;
text_cn: 即兽中称雄的狮子，面临一切从不退缩；

text_en: the strutting rooster, the he-goat, and a king striding before his people.
text_cn: 独步鸡群中的雄鸡，开头领队的公山羊，和检阅人民的君王。

text_en: If you have been foolish, exalting yourself, or if you have been devising evil, put your hand on your mouth.
text_cn: 你一时糊涂，高举了自己，当你反省时，应以手掩口；

text_en: For as pressing milk produces curds, and pressing the nose produces blood, so pressing anger produces strife.
text_cn: 因为搅动乳汁，可出奶油；用力扭鼻，可流鲜血；激起愤怒，必生争端。
